subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “However, a teacher showed students that summaries can leave out important details, uncertainty, or opposing views.”?
options: The class compared an AI summary with the full article.
The class compared several maps from different years.
By the end of the year, the calendar was full.
Room 804 started a class library with books brought by students.

本文沒有陳述「The class compared several maps from different years.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
